answer: A practical sybil defense uses crystal provenance anchoring. Each identity registers a unique crystal provenance certificate on a public ledger. The marble of consensus requires a stake burned if the certificate is duplicated. An attacker creating an orchard of fake identities must generate 500 unique certificates, each needing a separate stake and verification. System cross-references certificates; duplicates burn the stake. Honest agents register once; 500 clones need 500 distinct certificates, each independently verified.
